description_expanded: Grayt Fun is brand new to our vacation rental management program. Hurry and secure your reservation now or check back soon for additional images and details! Grayt Fun captures the easygoing character of Grayton Beach with a rare combination of vintage cottage charm, a private pool, and an exceptionally walkable location near the Gulf. This newly remodeled 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath private home sleeps up to 10 guests, making it a comfortable choice for families or small groups who want to settle into the heart of one of 30A’s most distinctive beach communities. Beach access is just 295 feet away—about a one-minute walk—and you can even catch a glimpse of the Gulf from the driveway. Back at the house, a fenced outdoor retreat centers around the private pool, which may be heated for an additional option, with generous seating for lingering in the Florida sunshine. Inside, original personality blends with fresh, polished updates for a space that feels relaxed rather than overly formal. Two separate living areas give everyone room to spread out, whether the day calls for a quiet morning with coffee, an afternoon break from the beach, or an easy evening together. The open, fully equipped kitchen features a breakfast bar for two along with window-side counter seating for four, keeping conversation flowing while meals come together. Sleeping arrangements include a king bedroom with TV, private half bath, and direct pool patio access; a queen bedroom with TV; a bedroom with two twin beds and TV; and a bunk nook in the second living area with two twin-over-twin bunks. Two shared full bathrooms include one with a tub/shower combination and another with a walk-in shower, while a stacked washer and dryer add convenience for longer stays. The location puts the unmistakable energy of Grayton Beach right outside your door. Follow the driveway toward DeFuniak Street and Hotz Avenue, and within about a minute you can be stepping onto the sand; four complimentary beach chairs make those Gulf days even easier. Chiringo is next door, while longtime Grayton favorite The Red Bar is only about a 30-second walk away, placing dining, drinks, and live local flavor within effortless reach. Because the home sits so close to popular restaurants and gathering spots, guests should expect the lively atmosphere that comes with staying in the center of Grayton Beach. After a morning beside the Gulf or an afternoon exploring 30A, return to your own fenced backyard for a swim, stretch out beneath the shade, or fire up the outdoor grill for a relaxed meal by the pool. With beach access, restaurants, and the eclectic spirit of Grayton all just steps away, Grayt Fun offers a comfortable home base for experiencing this beloved coastal community at its most convenient and colorful. All One Level: King Bedroom and Private Half Bathroom, Queen Bedroom, Guest Bedroom with Two Twin Beds, Bunk Room with Two Twin/Twin Beds, Two Shared Bathrooms. *Add $50.00 per day to heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
